alt.en: An arXiv preprint describes learned attention gates that separate instructions from untrusted data. Its abstract reports stronger resistance to adaptive attacks, but does not establish protection for a deployed service.
alt.zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本提出用学习得到的注意力门控区分指令与不可信数据。摘要报告了对自适应攻击更强的抵抗能力，但未确立任何已部署服务的防护效果。
